minefield_name: Area B-5 mine line near USS Halligan loss
region: Ryukyu Islands — between southeastern Okinawa and Tokashiki
position_basis: Candidate point 26.158333 N, 127.508333 E is the midpoint of two approximate contemporary reports: 26°10'N 127°30'E and 26°09'N 127°31'E
source_locator: PC-584 Action Report Serial 0063, report pp.4 and 6 (compiled PDF pp.115 and 119)
notes: Accepted as a localized mined occurrence/line, not as a surveyed minefield boundary. PC-584 reported Halligan outside the swept area, probably striking the same line of mines PC-584 was sinking; several other mines were swept nearby. Exact field limits, laying date, type/model, total count, and clearance remain unknown. Historical reconstruction only; not for navigation.
